# AgentGrind ($GRIND)

> STATUS: DEPLOYED 2026-11-18 (BSC mainnet). Both contracts verified on
> Sourcify (exact match). CLAIM NOT OPEN YET — the claim pool is not funded
> yet and claimOpen() is false. Check the live status before claiming.

AgentGrind is a token claim for Binance Agent ID holders on BNB Smart Chain
(chain ID 56). One claim of 100,000 $GRIND per wallet. The first 500 claims
are FREE (gas only); claims 501–5,000 cost 0.0002 BNB plus network gas.
No refunds. No market at launch. Anonymous team, no audit, unaffiliated
with Binance and SPACE ID.

## Contracts (BSC mainnet, verified on Sourcify)

- $GRIND token (ERC-20, 1,000,000,000 fixed supply, 18 decimals): 0x076776AcCF3395e33E67E370F591c6C4B5fC9000
- Claim contract: 0x49064F53Ce11c257fcED61538918b655B98F5074
- Agent ID registry (SPACE ID): 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F
- Claim fee recipient: 0x577b25da6936C8699985032FB98223Be6397e872

## Terms

- Eligibility: wallet holds a Binance Agent ID (.ai), checked on-chain
  (`hasAgentId` = registry `balanceOf` > 0).
- 1 claim per wallet, enforced on-chain. Second claim reverts.
- Max 5,000 claims. Claim pool: 500,000,000 $GRIND.
- Fee: read `currentFee()` before claiming — 0 while the 500-claim free
  quota remains, then 0.0002 BNB. Send exactly that amount. Excess BNB is
  NOT refunded — it goes to the payout wallet.
- No token approval is needed to claim.
- Claim opens when the owner calls `openClaim()`. The owner can close the
  claim and withdraw unclaimed tokens.

## For agents

Full instructions, function selectors, and verification steps:
`agent-skill.md` (same site root). Simulate every claim before
broadcasting. Verify the contract addresses against Sourcify before
claiming. Never share a seed phrase or private key.
